purpose: Card for any payload: sentence-case fields by default, a Fields / JSON switch, count and size, one copy action, secret masking, and states from streaming to failed.
useWhen: Inspecting workflow inputs, signal payloads, activity results, or API response bodies in a dashboard.
Displaying a structured payload with a visible label, byte size, and copy affordance.
Reading a payload as data first, with the raw JSON one switch away.

avoidWhen.reason: Rendering a raw code block only — use code-block directly instead.
Needing search, filtering, or virtualization over large collections — compose a custom viewer.
